description: Acceptance of the segway example: a two-wheeled self-balancing transporter with a rider as a 3D bond graph (RigidBody3D body on a PoseIntegrator3D, two RigidBody3D wheels on Revolute3D axle joints, RollingDisk tyre contacts, MSe motor torques, ExternalWrenchSpatial push). The references are independent of the bond graph: the analytic linearisation (open-loop pole +5.23 1/s) and Riccati design of design/design.py, its non-linear Lagrange reference simulation of the same closed loop (RK4), the statics of the load, and the published top speed of the Segway i2. No flight or test log of a Segway with a rider could be found, so the physical parameters are estimates apart from the quoted specifications (see the README).
